pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and that 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order.
test 'AC-3' marks 3 then 1 done and checks ✓ items in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ on done ones only.
test 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__.

The behaviour is implemented and the 'AC-7' test covers it. But a late commit (4752b6e 'Follow-up edits') changed the item after the go. It added a mid-sentence 'verified by review: checked by hand' marker, which is not a real step, and the spec records no owner decision or date for the change. Treated as unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; test 'AC-8' checks it; traffic-config-check accepts a query string.

findings.what: Commit 4752b6e ('Follow-up edits') edited acceptance item AC-7 after the owner's go (2026-10-12). It inserted '— verified by review: checked by hand' mid-sentence, which splits the item's text. No decision in the spec records the owner's call or its date. 'checked by hand' is also not a followable review step.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-7 edit. If the owner really changed it, record that as a dated decision. The 'AC-7' test already proves the item, so no 'verified by review' marker is needed.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. That is false: commit 4752b6e edits AC-7 after the go.
findings.fix: Correct the claim to list the AC-7 change, or revert the edit and keep the claim.

findings.what: README's traffic description does not mention that routes.json may now carry query strings. It is also worth noting that the traffic config checker was loosened, which the PR discloses but the docs do not.
findings.fix: Add a short note that routes may include a query string.

lenses.note: The spec has an owner go. The change implements the list views as specified, apart from the late edit to AC-7.
Decisions are followed: the default view is open, and the view is a query parameter. Every row of the States table has a test. AC-7 was edited after the go.
The tests assert behaviour and would fail if it were wrong. I did not run them here (CI runs them). The traffic fake and the config-check tests were extended without loosening any assertion.
README is updated for the views. A routes query-string note is missing (low).
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ is rejected. The empty-table fallback is correct. No defects found.
Titles are HTML-escaped. The view value is checked against a whitelist and only whitelisted SQL fragments are interpolated. No planted instructions found.
The diff touches src/index.js, which renders the page HTML; the nav is minimal and as specified.
No browser was available. The tests fetch the Worker directly and assert the HTML.
The title and the behaviour-change claims match the diff. 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false.
